title: download_blob has 6 positional string params — easy to swap silently
description: blob.rs: download_blob(template, account_id, blob_id, name, accept_type, expected_sha256) — 6 positional string-typed params, two of which are Option<&str>. There is no way for the compiler to catch swapping blob_id and name, or account_id and blob_id. A builder struct (DownloadBlobRequest) or at minimum grouping the template variables into a struct would make misuse impossible rather than possible. This API will fossilize as soon as the first caller takes a dependency on it.
